own.title: The SN-Ia host-mass step at the a0 scale
own.measured: Pantheon+ (N = 1548 Hubble-flow SNe), re-standardised from the raw SALT2 parameters (mu = mB + alpha x1 - beta c; the released MU already removes the step through its bias corrections); host masses from the release; hosts matched to SDSS DR17 by position for sizes (N = 449) and local surface brightness (N = 450)
assumptions: the disc mass-size relation that turns M* into g_bar
own.standing: a real step of -0.050 +- 0.007 mag (6.9 sigma) sits where g_bar crosses a0 (log M* 9.6-10.2 vs the step at 10); the decisive fixed-mass test finds acceleration adds nothing beyond mass (partial +0.030 vs mass -0.170) but has only 18% (23% alt) power against the framework's own step model
own.shift: the crossing mass moves with the mass-size relation (+-0.3 dex) and the footing (Sigma_a0 x1.21 on the alt footing); the step's amplitude moves with the standardisation (Pantheon+'s bias correction carries -0.070 mag)
own.lcdm_same: LCDM reads the same step as a progenitor age / dust / metallicity effect; the fixed-mass null is equally consistent with it
own.note: the step is model-independent; its a0 ATTRIBUTION is untested (underpowered), not refuted
own.keep: keep the step (-0.050 +- 0.007 mag at log M* ~ 10); any construction that ties it to a0 must predict a fixed-mass acceleration dependence, which the present sample cannot see (80% power needs a 0.142 mag step)

own.title: The environmental null: a0 tracks rho_Lambda, not the local density (the BIG-SPARC pipeline)

assumptions: M/L (the naive correlation vanishes in gas-dominated and Q = 1 subsamples)
the EFE confound (environment also enters through the external field)
own.standing: the rho_local fork (d log a0/d log rho_env = +1/2) is excluded at 13-34 sigma on 175 SPARC; no committed .out (the number is the committed ledger EMPIRICAL_TESTS.md A14)
own.shift: a +1/2 slope over the density range probed is far beyond the ~0.1 dex M/L systematics; residual trends of 0.02-0.05 dex need BIG-SPARC
own.lcdm_same: LCDM has no a0; its emergent RAR scale is also environment-independent in simulations
own.note: the no-circularity rule holds: a0 from each galaxy's own points, density from an external catalogue
own.keep: a0 must not depend on the ambient density (|d log a0/d log rho_env| << 1/2); the source is the cosmic rho_Lambda

own.title: The Lyman-alpha forest b-cutoff sign
own.measured: the lower cutoff b0(z) of the Doppler-parameter distribution of forest absorbers (Hiss et al. 2018, 8 bins at z = 2.0-3.4), against the framework's gas acceleration at the forest's density
assumptions: the b0 calibration (Hiss vs Rudie: 3.36 km/s)
which acceleration counts for forest gas (the x-convention spans 3.4 dex)

own.note: a weak, convention-dominated tension, not an exclusion
own.keep: the b0 cutoff sign (framework b above b0) must not grow beyond the calibration channel's 0.4-0.9 sigma in a construction's forest-gas acceleration
